title: Broken rendering due to tabs in file content
body: Whenever claude code suggests code changes it looks weird like this, with the border on the right wrapping to a newline. I have wrapping disabled in this buffer. If I resize it, the text resizes, but still is wonky with the new lines. After accepting the change, it looks fine: Is there a way to get this border to properly render, or disable the border entirely when looking at the suggestion diff view? I am running claud code in a neovim terminal.
author: trevorwhitney
